definitions.explanation: An establishment licensed for hair cutting, shaving, and grooming services. In Japan, legally distinct from a beauty salon (美容室), as barbershops are licensed for shaving with razors.

examples.japanese: {理容室|りようしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I got my hair cut at the barbershop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{理容室|りようしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new barbershop opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{理容室|りようしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My father goes to the same barbershop every month.

notes:
FORMS:
{理容|りよう} (barbering, grooming) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room, establishment).

USAGE:
In Japan, {理容室|りようしつ} (barbershop) and ⟦{美容室|びようしつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧ (beauty salon) are legally different categories. Barbershops can perform shaving ({顔剃|かおそ}り) with razors, which beauty salons cannot. Barbershops traditionally cater more to men, though this distinction is softening.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美容室|びようしつ}→美容室：20238_biyoushitsu⟧/⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧: beauty salon, hair salon
- ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: barber (informal, everyday term)
- ⟦{散髪屋|さんぱつや}→散髪屋：29495_sanpatsuya⟧: barber (casual)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理容室|りようしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the barbershop
- {理容室|りようしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to book an appointment at the barbershop
